description: Implementation of SHA-1 hashing algorithm in C, including functions for initialization, updating, and finalizing the hash, with test vectors and core transformation logic.

methods.name: SHA1Transform
methods.description: Core function that processes a 512-bit block to update the SHA-1 hash state.

methods.name: SHA1Init
methods.description: Initializes the SHA-1 context with constants.

methods.name: SHA1Update
methods.description: Updates the hash with new data, processing in 64-byte chunks.

methods.name: SHA1Final
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, adds padding, and outputs the digest.
